description: Non-binding monthly estimate for Accent cloud phone and team messaging plans at the published 36-month rates on https://www.accentvoice.com/plans-pricing/ (users × per-user plan price, plus published add-ons). Month-to-month, other terms and annual-billing online-order pricing are not quoted here: request a formal quote. Omit plan to get every plan; monthly.low_from / high_from name the plan behind each end of the range (each plan carries its tagline, e.g. Team is team messaging). Excludes taxes, fees, usage and one-time charges. Each estimate lists the plan's included features as published on the Plans & Pricing page. No personal data needed. For a binding price, send the person to next_steps.formal_quote_url.

term.description: 36_month (default) = the published plan-card price. month_to_month is not quoted by this tool: it returns term_not_supported with a formal-quote link.
